# ZeisWorks

> ZeisWorks builds VIKs — Visualized Institutional Knowledge: a firm's operating knowledge written into plain files that its team and its AI both read. AI assistants and automations then run on those files, so every answer traces to a source and the knowledge survives staff turnover. Built for professional services firms of roughly 10–50 people. Engagements start with a free intro call, then a fixed-price one-week Knowledge Audit, then ongoing build-and-run at $2,500/month, month to month. Clients keep every file at every step.

## What ZeisWorks does

- Writes down how a firm defines, prices, and runs its work in plain, readable files
- Builds AI assistants and automations that read those files to do real work: proposals, answers, reporting, onboarding
- Every answer cites the file it came from; when something's wrong, you fix the file, not the whole system
- Everything is portable — the same files work with whichever AI model is best next year

## Who it's for

- Consulting and advisory firms: https://zeisworks.com/for/consulting-firms
- Agencies and studios: https://zeisworks.com/for/agencies
- Other professional services firms where knowledge is the product
